page.overview:
What is Unidentified fishing crew?

A fishing crew was a small crew led by Wan'yek Whett In that time, Sakavian Skoova Stev joined the group, and in return the fishing group would abstain from fishing on his homeworld planet Sakavi Tar. However, when Stev was separated from the group, Whett was back fishing on Sakavi Tar.

The fishing crew was first mentioned in Respawn Entertainment's Star Wars Jedi: Survivor which released on April 28, 2023.
